title: Top N Records Per Group Pattern
realWorldScenario: The homepage needs to show the top 1 highest-priced product for every category.
questionStatement: Write a query using a CTE and `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC)` to retrieve only the #1 most expensive product in each category. Return `category`, `name`, and `price`, ordered by `category` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Top 1 most expensive product per category
WITH ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    name,
    price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT
  category,
  name,
  price
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY category ASC;
expectedConcepts: CTE wrapping to filter window output
hints: You cannot put WHERE ROW_NUMBER() = 1 in the same query.
Wrap the query in a CTE or subquery, then filter WHERE rn = 1.

testCases.description: Verify single top-priced product per category
